notes.title: Last Man Standing mode, sequel and daily deal!
notes.content:
Greetings, Players and Officers! Exciting news awaits you!

We are here to showcase the latest addition to our game, [i]Prison Simulator[/i] - a brand new mode ! And the best part? It will be available for free and is [b]available now![/b] ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/76c22df7656807238489cbb0623129ece6ebbe58.png[/img]

[h2]Daily Deal! - get Prison Simulator on the biggest discout ever![/h2]

These are not all surprises!
In addition to the free add-on and the daily deal, we are creating a sequel to [i]Prison Simulator [/i]for you, in which you will play the role of a prisoner!
See it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/Prison_Survival_Architect_of_Crime_Simulator/ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1b9a13d5ee68eafef5d76a575f884120682d4a0f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/b][/h1]

Introducing [i]Last Man Standing [/i]- an adrenaline-fueled experience where your primary objective is to escape the prison alive! Brace yourself as a riot wreaks havoc within the prison facility. In an unexpected twist, you, as a guard, must find a way to break free. Quite the ironic situation, isn't it? ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode takes a more action-oriented approach, inspired by the immensely popular Riot Event in the full game. We've amplified the action to reach the players who crave intense gameplay within the prison walls.

[h1][b]Getting started[/b][/h1]

Getting started in [i]Last Man Standing[/i] is no cakewalk. You'll begin in a modest office, stripped of weapons or tools. Armed only with your trusty fists, you must fight your way out. Diplomacy won't be of any use this time; the prisoners are furious and thirst for your blood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4e2fc1ccd08d3874ff32f82b8cf22279411c9db2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Gear up![/b][/h1]

Unleash your fists and engage in combat! Remember to defend yourself by right-clicking to block incoming attacks, but keep a keen eye on your stamina bar.

Thankfully, amidst the chaos and riot, you can scavenge useful items to aid your escape. A riot gun will be indispensable; trust me, you won't want to navigate this mode without it!

Beware of the stronger enemies we've introduced in recent updates to the Riot Event. They've returned for more! Stay on guard against mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons! (they can sometimes even have firearms!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Entirely new prison![/b][/h1]

Prepare to be captivated by an entirely new prison we've crafted for this mode. We had a blast designing it! Once you've escaped (or unfortunately met your demise), a pop-up will display your performance score, including time taken and prisoners neutralized. Strive for the highest score and aim for greatness! (Three difficulty mods available!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you in action within the thrilling world of [i]Prison Simulator![/i]


Best regards,
Baked Games Team

We are working now on several things right now and oneof it is a absolutely [b]new[/b] mode in Prison Simulator! This new mode will be distributed [b]for free[/b] ! 

[h2]Last Man Standing - what are the rules?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4768ae54be6d512a6500c84b19b06412de24be9b.gif[/img]

The rules is simple - get out of prison alive !! The vile riot is destroying prison facility. You have no other choice but to escape ! (it's funny that the guard must escape prison, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/97843b0c3248075f4a2d63364312878868e6375e.gif[/img]

This mode is actually action-oriented. We know that you liked a Riot Event from full game a lot ;) so we added some more action in prison for fans ;)

[h2]Getting started[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c4838c3406dbde0b3bfdbaafe439a55f6585f700.gif[/img]

First you will find yourself without weapons or items in small office...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/dbf8530693e68a355ec8a6be395dd607d943654c.gif[/img]

You got only your trusty fists! Fight your way out! Persuading won't help you this time - prisoners are mad and wants your blood!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/14c31b852f600897d6b5a223a7cb25f7ffe99c18.gif[/img]

Use fists to fight! Remember you can press RMB to defend yourself. But watch a [b]stamina bar[/b] !!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/bc142de2c3a6ebf5cd4ee2812c46086ef76218f7.gif[/img]

Also you can HOLD an attack button to charge a powerfull PUNCH ! No one can resist that !

[h2]This is where a fun begins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7d14e81c23e2edf8b54ed8172869e3933615a493.gif[/img]

Fortunately in this mess and riot you can still find some usefull items. A riot gun is mandatory, i haven't finished this mode without it ever once :D  
And don't worry about prisoners health - it works on non-lethal bullets !

[h2]Stronger enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b34e4a92cfa13fb1f0888ef1f26c924d3d9cfd09.gif[/img]

In one of the updates we added some stronger prisoners to Riot Event. 
Unfortunately they came back for more!! Watch out for mini-bosses with stolen body armor and weapons and also for a tricky ones with GUNS!! Most dangerous ones! You have to defeat them in order to progress through some rooms

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/34cfd1c505fc0b8beae4021e2d3b421d89fa51d9.gif[/img]

[h2]Entarily new prison![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/45d99ce905fb10090f67e57d06e3322c01866328.gif[/img]

We made a entairly new prison for this mode ! It was fun making it ! Hope you won't get lost ;)
After escaping (or after death) you will get a pop up with some informations of how well did you 
did. You know: time passed, prisoners neutralized etc. Try to aim for the best score!

I hope this mode will get you some challenge and fun! It's [b]almost[/b] ready to be published, please be patient and wait for some more info about future of Prison Simulator - you won't be dissapointed ;)


Watch our social medias especially [url=https://twitter.com/Baked_Games]Twitter[/url] and join our Discord for more behind the scenes footage ;)

notes.title: Prison Simulator: Prologue - Achievements Reveal
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Guards,[/h2]

You've been working very diligently these past few months, the inmates even tolerate you, but...

Can you handle the latest challenge that Prison Simulator: Prologue will throw at you? Can you get them all?

[h3]All right, enough with the serious motivational speech, time for Friday's news![/h3]

In [b]Prison Simulator: Prologue[/b] you will be able to see some of the achievements that you are familiar with from the demo version. The decision to include them in the next part was based on the complexity of the gameplay in the prologue itself.

Which of the achievements will return, you will see for yourselves, in the meantime we will present to you the achievements that you don't know yet.

[b]1.Not on my watch![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0bfb0f866522fcb09417e97be94d92b85119b76e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/105062088b9aa9b87d511d1752998f69dee444c4.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is one of the easiest and hardest at the same time. To get it, all you have to do (or as much as) is master rebellion. Simple right? Not one daredevil has tried to do it, but not one has fallen in the fight against the convicts.

[b]2 - Diplomat[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/630d49025071e628b1597ad68e0eda9f90bd1c44.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4872f0b03184e27b0bc03005dec1d3f2f77ecee.png[/img][/url]

What's there to say. We solve problems with talk, not fists. So much for that. And if you don't like talking, there are only fists left, but this achievement won't be for you.

[b]3 No guns allowed[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ffd06485fff10fc1aee826e493ff75e5bd4d283f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e4b5ee4845e4a9679f2c51f4f6dfb052ee08e403.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is reserved for true professionals. The prison is on fire, the convicts are vandalizing everything they can, the guards are running scared... and in the middle of it all - YOU. The hero of the prison, the guard of all guards, who deals with such problems without reaching for a gun. Is it a dream or a reality?

[b]4. The story begins[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0633869e0fdad85d0c19a82a4d628ed96f72ad1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2abcf9b934d522711c19e7a81752a41692411bb3.png[/img][/url]

This achievement is for persistent players who complete Prison Simulator: Prologue. And that's it. 

[b]5. Finders keepers[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/98bffe0bda00735b9de118096c051c36eab242ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a1e45cd8bd89ff06bc00b095ea9d9a0f68adbee.png[/img][/url]

Fortunately, our prison facility... Oops, it's not that easy!

[b]6. Student[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a32d85b1c94754b044caaed2f2adaaf89362a2ec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8f3a48ef6c8dc95dcdc5a8d94c0f86dc7d468524.png[/img][/url]

Remember those days when you went to school? Or do you still go to school? This achievement will make you feel like you're in a real... we're kidding.

Purchase the first skill to unlock this achievement. This skill will REALLY come in handy for you.

[b]7. Rambo[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4ff6b37e44b515dc966f89242472f739569f7e05.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/75c3cc390a98acf24e676149bbe863074c2ce7bf.png[/img][/url]

I don't think we need to explain...


[b]That's all we wanted to show you today. 
Let us know in the comments which achievement you like best![/b]

And if you've earned all of the achievements while playing the demo, join our Discord server where we look forward to seeing your screenshots!

[h3]Interact with one of them using the key (default: E) and see what you can buy.
On the left side you will see your inventory divided into two tabs: legal and illegal. On the right side you will see all items currently available for purchase.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/93a58109d09c86afa1358833b88da0bef0af799f.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE - Free time changes, new mini games, better collectibles and more...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h3]We are glad you played our Halloween demo update. Many of you unlocked special achievement! To get it you had to collect all candies hidden in the prison. Wow! You are awesome.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/06b4eb735d14cc5978244a1259773c104a5dfa58.png[/img]

[h3]But Halloween time is ending. It won't be available soon. 
Don't worry! We are working on another way how you can get this time-limited achievement if you are an achiev-hunter. More info will be published soon.[/h3]

[h2]It is the time to take a look at Free Time.[/h2]

[h3]A few days ago we asked you what do you think about our demo. 
Your feedback is the most important for us, because without it we don't know what exactly we should improve. [/h3]

[h3]Today, we want to focus on Free Time. Some of you said there are not many mini games, you have to do always the same and the longer you play the more boring it is. [/h3]

[h3]In our demo you don't have access to all features. 
You could visit shooting range, play darts and lift weights.[/h3]

[h3]We want to tell you a bit more about activities, that will be available in full version.[/h3]


[h2]1, Weapons cleaning[/h2]

[h3]This mini game will be available in the shooting range. when the gun gets dirty, it may not work properly. On the shooting range you will find a special stand that will make the cleaning process easier. You will find there cloths, ramrod and all necessary tools. We are also working on different weapons to make this mini game interesting and various.[/h3]

[h2]2. Lock picking[/h2]

[h3]Sometimes prisoners like to destroy something. One of their favorite activities is clogging locks. Your task is to get rid of the problem. Can you do it? You need to get inside the lock to be able to fix it.[/h3]

[h2]3. Clogged showers[/h2]

[h3]During the shower routine one of the prisoners decided to push something into the shower headset. Great idea, You have to take care of it now. Remember to look well. Sometimes it is just sabotage and sometimes it is a great opportunity to hide something illegal.
[/h3]
[h2]4. Fix a broken camera[/h2]

[h3]As a guard you want to know everything and see everyone. With the help of cameras it is even easy. But sometimes the cameras get damaged, hang up or just refuse to cooperate. Find a broken camera and look inside to fix it.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a7d57e4225c9f099f5f3a89d8ee80818157aed3.png[/img]


[h3]We think that those mini games will be fresh, interesting and you will have fun! [/h3]

[h3]During the free time you will have vaious side quests to complete. You can get them from both quards and prisoners. They are connected to smuggling, finding lost items etc. Shhh! We don't spoil.[/h3]


[h2]The last thing for today is that we completely changed the Collectibles system.[/h2] 

[h3]They have gained a new user interface, 3D preview and a panel in the journal, which allows you to check the progress and discover tips which will help you with the next items. The reward system has also been improved. For finding all 10 collectibles the player receives:
[/h3]
[h3]- $500 for the player (in-game currency)
- $500 for prison (in-game currency)
- a special skin for one of the items
- Steam's achievement.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/27d53a11ea6f62f4318cfdebbe9f91a225a700cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e2adfac9363a8052299715774393487045b38b50.png[/img]
[h2]That's all for today. 
Have a nice Monday![/h2]

[h3]Cheers :)
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/db5892e08b0bb4af133a1b16bd3d96795b90852d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/b0084e47ae89eb2230d612ba585add0bdc6129d5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Well, we took a piece of paper and wrote down everything that we wanted to put into our game. We had only one question: how to put this into the computer? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/6cac472f700979901291b5c921a7483dc5269b89.jpg[/img]
[h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/4c5fe93a86f569be2b31f82063d9ed6a000bb257.png[/img]

[h3]Prison Simulator was an enormous project. It had to contain artificial intelligence, a large prison facility, many routines, items, quests, and even influential dialogues! Our designer wrote a Game Design Document, but nobody was able to read it because it has hundreds of pages. The description and total content were extremely wide.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/33b4511194a77685eadf5aff739b9210f0027743.png[/img]

[h3]Finally, prisoners got their conversations, quests, and the possibility to trade with the player. They act like normal people. They are original![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/816b15544458b7fcc23da739003ed9197d0dd191.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f6f415b41122d5edaeffb1c8b006f9288f0c8261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/61ab4b7aa0d3fb886de11eb8e613b14a4070d1aa.png[/img]

[h3]Prison Simulator includes its own story, random events, and side quests. You can either enjoy your free time by playing minigames or fix broken things - cameras, showers, or even weapons![/h3]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guards,[/h1]

[h2]We are glad you played our game. It is very important to know your opinion. You've written many reports and given us amazing feedback. It is awesome. [/h2]

[h2]We fixed some bugs and add general improvements.

Take a look:[/h2]
[h3]
GENERAL[/h3]

We fixed teleportation issue visible between the workshop and the solitary quest. Now prisoners go back to their cells without any special effects.

We've changed the key responsible for weapon selection wheel from "MMB" to "Q".

Dialogues with prisoners with high respect level are now shown as they should.

[h3]WORKSHOP[/h3]

Prisoner who started fire during the workshop routine is no more afraid of going back to his cell. Congratulation Prisoner. 

We have also fixed waypoints in the workshop so prisoners know where should they be. No more walking around the workshop.

[h3]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]

Achievement "The cause of fire was fire" is now easier to receive.

[h3]YARD[/h3]

Timer from lifting weights quest starts after the tutorial, not during reading popups as before.

[h3]SHOOTING RANGE[/h3]

Accuracy is now counted properly.

Your game no more ends before finish conditions.

Your records looks much better than before.

[h3]TRANSLATIONS[/h3]

We changed translations and fixed spelling issues in both Polish and English version.

[h3]DIALOGUES[/h3]

We've added three new dialogues between you and the prisoners.
Two when you talk to easy prisoner, and one when you talk to neutral prisoner.

Pro tip: Milk bars are very, very needed!

[h3]PARCELS[/h3]

Items have fixed sizes and they look cool now. 

We fixed joints positions in a lower can. They don't go out of the item now.

Materials of cans are lighter so they match other items.


Hope you like our Demo! 

Best greetings from Baked Games Team :)))

[h1]Hello Players![/h1]

[h2]It is Monday again... but! We hope that we can make you happy with our new update.[/h2]

[h3]Today we want to focus on prisoners because they are the most important part of prison system. 
We've shown you characters creator, choosing names, voices and bodies for your convicts. Now it is the time to show you their life and how does it look like in our facility. Take a look![/h3]

Prisoners spend most time in the cells block - Block B. Here they have beds, sinks, toilets and other furniture that you buy during the game.

You interact with them during presence check routine, you take them to the canteen and keep order there, you also go to the workshop where they work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/f2b14b838e92bb15ed6942cf63399b2995f8ce87.png[/img]

Prisoners have three types of personality: they can be polite and nice, neutral, and rude or even aggressive.

You can search the prisoner whenever you want. You're the guard, you set the rules. 

Prisoners may start fire, try to damage walls or just fight with other guys. You never know what they are planning. Maybe one day they will begin the riot? You will see...

More about prisoners' behaviour we will tell you during the next livestream so don't forget to check updates to be up to date.

[h3]Enjoy![/h3]

notes.title: Journal - the most important panel in the game.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Guys![/h1]

[h2]We are glad to come to you with a new update!
Last week was full of hard work and we had to deal with many issues. 
Now we want to show you new features and give you an answer about dealing with prisoners![/h2]


[h1]Player Journal[/h1]

In the journal there are six labels which contain the most important information about inventory, quests and stuff like that. 

The first label - equipment. Here you can see all of your items. You can also asign food to one of the pocekts slots to access them by pressing Z or X on your keyboard. Different types of food and drinks change your stamina or health level so it is important to buy it. In case of long distance running or just ordinary fighting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e1a27e2b97f2be55d6f6f3f00c54daf311b6a965.png[/img]

Second label - quests. This is your personal assistant. You can check what quests you have already done, and how many of them you still have to complete. Under the primary list you can see side quests. Whenever you accept a quest from prisoners it will be availiable right here. Completed quests have "success" description. So it is easy to see your progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7886b8100c52252dfd3093205550fefce56d3a6d.png[/img]

Third label - map. Here you can see all your facility. Prison is a large building so you will need some help at the beginning. On the right side you have a list with all the most important places in your prison. Monitoring room, Warden's office or shooting range... Everything in one place. You can also see some icons like gamepad or a triangle. Gamepads icons mean that there you can play some mini games like lifting weights or darts, triangle shows your position. It is quite simple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c54f712d3f0402fd4eecead2c1c53c7dc8382bab.png[/img]

Collectibles. Hmmm. That's quite interesting. Some items are hidden in prison. And this is all what we can say. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/994ff1b5f3fb0ccbc3a678705e53f35d13e1b2e4.png[/img]

You can trade with more inmates and it depends on how much respect is between you and them. Nothing hard. Skills can be upgraded but you have to reach required level to have a chance to buy them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/77c0ad944c58b9d6b13e17ef971799240e1279eb.png[/img]

The last thing in our journal is tutorial. If you forget anything about the game you can go there and just check it. You will see game tips here as well. It is something like: "Hey mom did you see my pants?" She always know where your things are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/d8ffcf0c7e2dac166a235605f2e062e3ec098393.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #11 - Custom beds, custom crates, custom... toilets?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players![/h1]

[h2]We are coming to you with a fresh update![/h2]

[h3]Previous week was quite exhausting. We've been working on new features, new dialogs and new addons. It is important for us to make our game completed. We want to take care about all details. We listen to our players and we decided to change the walls because old ones weren't matchy. It is fully understable. So here it is! 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1ce67cd77c42287805ec7ee720c9d709cbb61677.png[/img]

You have to rememeber that this is a screenshot from development build so it may change a bit before the official release. 
We decided to use concrete walls instead of bricks. The prison cells are more bright and they look bigger. It also resolved the problem with wall paitings. Now they look nice and fresh. We think, the new style is much better. What do you think about it? 

We also improved lights a bit and added some details and more props. Going back to the requests. We changed the bed textures in our infirmary because previous one was too dirty and there was blood on it. After deep reserch, finding photos and reading we created new texture with quite clean duvet. We thinik it is now how it should be but take a look and say what you think. Your feedback is very important for us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/e850e653791b2e4a1e5c2938c31bf9fe964f9810.png[/img]

The next thing is customization panel. First you have to reach required level and complete needed quest. Then you can go to the warden's room and use his computer. It is easy. Just press E key while looking at the screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c322b9356ea40f215d710753983ebedeff8f435e.png[/img]

You have few options here. At the moment he most important is an option to buy new skins for your objects like sinks, beds and even crates! We wanted to give you a chance to customize the prison and feel like it is yours. We prepared few different skins. From the ordinary, not so good-looking to lavish and luxury ones (for example - golden crates). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7f598e8ae6fd39a5306d93719c63ba3c0fcd3801.png[/img]

This is all what we wanted to show you after the whole week. We are so excited that we can provide you more screens, movies and even streams. We are creating an awesome community together. 

Cheers,
and see you next time!

notes.title: Update #9 - prisoners, fights and other miracles...
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear Players![/h1]

We are glad you were with us during the last livestream. We hope you are satisfied and you like the general look of our game. It is very important for us to stay in touch with you, and to show you the game even if it is still in development. We are adding new content and improving existing one. The best idea is to provide you many hours of good gameplay. That's why we are working on many additional quests not only connected to the main story.

First of all we want to end demo version to let some of you play Prison Simulator. We need to add some details and make sure everything is ok. Your feedback is very important for us because we are able to change something or fix bugs which we didn't notice. 

As we wrote before we are adding more parcels with different items inside to make it various. They are randomly generated so it is essential to preserve diversity.

We are also improving prisoners' behaviour during the attendance check routine. When you go to the cells block you have to open the cells. During this time, the prisoners leave their cells, but some stay in them. So you have to go up to them and talk to them. They'll give you all sorts of reasons why they don't want to go to the assembly. Sometimes it can make you laugh. You decide if you be polite and patient or if you force them to go to the rally. Your choice. 

During that routine you can notice that some prisoners are fighting. You need to react quickly enough. Once you have controlled the situation, it is your job to report the behaviour by radio and give the right punishment for an aggressive convict. It can be for example:

[list]
[*] no phones
[*] solitary
[*] no pass
[*] no cell leaving
[/list]

and more...

[i] If you want to stay tuned don't forget to join our discord server:[/i]
https://discord.gg/m56PEev


[i]Visit our Facebook:[/i]
https://www.facebook.com/prisonsimulator


Thank you so much for your attention,
Best wishes!

notes.title: Update #8 - Naughty prisoners...
notes.content:
[h2]Naughty prisoner? A fight? Attack on a guard?[/h2]
[h3]That's why we added different types of weapons to our game.[/h3]

Taser is available in the weapon selection wheel (open by pressing the middle mouse button).
It paralyzes your opponent within a few seconds so that he is confused or even unconscious. 

You have to rememeber that your stun gun has a limited battery so don't waste the energy. 

You may be able to stop the riot or an aggressive prisoner...


There is a tutorial which will help you with weapons and the ways of using them. So don't worry you won't feel lost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7e0be479674a8c406625dfdae13ac0e34975ae3f.png[/img]

You can paralyze the prisoners who break the rules. They may be so aggressive so don't let them attack you or another guard. You have the power...at least when the battery is charged. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7b3cacb85d2818a6722b1f6c5b345b2adcd5919f.jpg[/img]

Sometimes you can also attack your mates. Maybe he drunk your coffee? Or he was not so nice? Your choice. Good luck!

notes.title: Update#5 Character creator (movie)
notes.content:
At the beginning you will be able to customize your prisoners using avalible face and body models. You will have an option to choose the type and the pitch of their voices. You will also decide how you want to call them.

[previewyoutube=eZwk5ZMg8OE;full]
[/previewyoutube]

If you don't want to waste your time, you don't have to set the appearance of all of the 16 guys. "Random" and "Random all" functions are the major time savers! The first feature will help you with a single character, and the second one - with all the unfinished inmates.
What about new prisoners? Don't worry. You don't have to create them. The game will do that for you. :)
Then the "gang creator" comes. You can assign your convicts to the specific gangs. Also, you will be able to choose the gangs' names and symbols which will represent them. Gangs will influence the course of the gameplay.
